description: Prices one NFL bet against a fair line: win, push and lose chances, the fair price, expected value per $100, break-even, and a quarter-Kelly stake with the uncertainty haircut, plus what buying or selling half a point is worth (key numbers 3 and 7 priced off real NFL margins, not a bell curve) and teasers. Default fair line is the consensus number; pass your own fair line, total or win probability to price your view. For 'is DAL -3.5 at -110 worth it', 'what are the fair odds on over 47.5', 'should I buy the hook to +3', 'what's KC +3 worth in a 6-point teaser', 'how much should I bet'. Information only: it computes; it never places a bet.

away.description: Away team, when naming a game.

bankroll.description: Bankroll in dollars, to turn the Kelly fraction into a stake.

bet.description: The bet in plain words, e.g. 'DAL -3.5 -110', 'over 47.5', 'PHI ML +300', 'KC +3 teaser'. Parsed into the fields below; explicit fields win.

fair_line.description: Your own fair spread for this side, if you have one.

fair_win_prob.description: Your win probability for this side, 0-1.

home.description: Home team, when naming a game.

line.description: The side's line, e.g. -3.5 or +7, or the total, e.g. 47.5.

market.description: Market (default spread; total when side is over/under).

opponent_price.description: The other side's price, to strip the vig from a moneyline.

price.description: American price, e.g. -110 or +120 (decimal like 1.91 also works). Default -110.

team.description: Team: abbreviation, city or nickname, e.g. DAL, Dallas, Cowboys.

name: price_line
title: Is this bet worth it? Fair odds, win chance and value of a spread, total or moneyline
